name: Vienna
summary: Vienna combines imperial palaces, the best quality of life in Europe according to numerous rankings and an unrivaled cultural scene, with impeccable public transport. As an EU citizen, settling there does not require a visa or special procedures. It is a quiet, safe and very orderly city, ideal for those looking for stability and quality of life over frenetic nightlife.
